answer: Reputation then grows along a vine of peer attestations: new participants start with zero weight, and every fake account must earn independent attestations from distinct real peers, multiplying attacker cost per sybil while honest agents compound trust cheaply. Each agent stakes a unique proof-of-work crystal bound to its reputation slot and a juniper-scented hardware key, so cloning an identity requires re-mining the crystal at escalating cost. In practice, Agent0005 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
